description: This file defines Vulkan format utilities for ANGLE's Vulkan renderer, including format structures, support checks, and format table management.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan format with associated properties and initialization methods.

classes.name: FormatTable
classes.description: Manages a table of Format objects indexed by angle::FormatID, providing format lookup and initialization.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the internalFormat is valid (non-zero).

methods.name: intendedFormat
methods.description: Returns the front-end format associated with the Format object.

methods.name: actualImageFormat
methods.description: Returns the actual image format used for textures or renderbuffers.

methods.name: actualBufferFormat
methods.description: Returns the actual buffer format used for buffer objects.

methods.name: getInternalFormatInfo
methods.description: Retrieves internal format information for a given GLenum type.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Format object with renderer and angle format.

methods.name: initImageFallback
methods.description: Sets up fallback image format information.

methods.name: initBufferFallback
methods.description: Sets up fallback buffer format information.
